text: {"rules":[{"id":"VAR-CATCHUP-7-18","version":"2025","title":"Varicella 2-dose series complete for persons age 7-18 years without evidence of immunity","source_quote":"Ensure persons age 7–18 years without evidence of immunity","grade":"not graded (CDC/ACIP routine and catch-up schedule recommendation)","effective_date":"2025","action":"Ensure a 2-dose varicella-containing vaccine series (VAR or MMRV) has been received","denominator":"{\"all\":[{\"age\":{\"min\":7,\"max\":18,\"at\":\"end\"},\"quote\":\"persons age 7–18 years\"},{\"uncomputable\":{\"needs\":\"evidence of varicella immunity (documented disease history, laboratory evidence, or other ACIP immunity criteria)\"},\"quote\":\"without evidence of immunity\"}]}","numerator":"{\"immunization\":{\"concept\":\"varicella_containing_vaccine\",\"min_count\":2,\"window\":[\"{MY-18}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"]},\"quote\":\"2-dose series\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"doses may be given any time from birth; the oldest patient in the denominator is 18, so a window starting 18 years before the measurement year covers any patient's whole lifetime\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["New concept used: varicella_containing_vaccine = any varicella-containing dose (VAR or MMRV), because the text says 'VAR or MMRV may be administered' and mixed series (e.g. VAR then MMRV) must count together; the vocabulary has separate varicella_vaccine and mmrv_vaccine concepts only.","Routine schedule timing (dose 1 at 12–15 months, dose 2 at 4–6 years) is not encoded as separate age-specific rules (e.g. dose 1 expected by age 2, two doses by age 7) because that would require derived ages; completion is checked only through the age 7–18 rule.","Minimum age (12 months) for a valid dose is not checked; doses given before 12 months would be counted.","Minimum intervals are not checked: dose 2 as early as 3 months after dose 1 (age 12 and under; a dose after at least 4 weeks may be counted as valid) and 4–8 weeks routine / 4 weeks minimum interval for age 13 and older.","Product choice not represented: for dose 1 at age 12–47 months MMR and varicella vaccines are recommended to be given separately, with MMRV allowed by parent/caregiver preference; maximum age for MMRV is 12 years.","Evidence of immunity (per MMWR rr5604) is not computable from structured data; the denominator therefore includes an uncomputable criterion and the rule will report 'not computable' unless immunity status is supplied.","Contraindications/precautions are not listed in this section and are not represented as exclusions."]}
